name: Theme System
description: Theme singleton managing color palette selection and application. Provides three base themes (Default, Monokai, Idol) each with dark and light variants. Exports typed ThemeColors for each variant. apply() sets 14 CSS custom properties (--bg, --surface, --panel, --primary, --secondary, --tertiary, --border, --accent, --accent2, --green, --amber, --red, --onAccent, --scrim) on document root. Supports setTheme() with legacy name mapping, setDark() toggle, and direct setBase/setMode.

properties.name: isDark
properties.description: True if current mode is dark

properties.name: colors
properties.description: Computed color object for the active theme

methods.name: setBase
methods.description: Switch base palette preserving current mode

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Set both base and mode with legacy name fallback mapping

methods.name: setDark
methods.description: Toggle to default dark or light

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Flip between dark and light on the current base

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Apply all 14 CSS custom properties to document root

lifecycle.created_by: Module import (singleton instantiates and calls apply() immediately)
